metadata.title: SOCRadar-Alarm-Import
metadata.description: NOT RECOMMENDED - deploy azuredeploy.json in the repository root instead, which installs this and wires the permissions it needs. Imports alarms from SOCRadar with optional audit logging and custom table storage. Supports all statuses or OPEN only.
metadata.author: SOCRadar

metadata.description: NOT RECOMMENDED: deploy azuredeploy.json from the repository root instead. --- Name of the Logic App
SOCRadar Platform API Key
SOCRadar Company ID
Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics Workspace Name
Polling interval in minutes (1-60)
Initial lookback in minutes for first run (10-10080, default 600 = 10 hours)
Import all alarm statuses including resolved/closed. Default: only OPEN alarms

Direct: the import Logic App creates one Microsoft Sentinel incident per SOCRadar alarm (current behaviour). AlertBacked: the import writes alarms to the SOCRadar_Alarms_CL table and a scheduled analytics rule raises one alert and one incident per alarm, so the incidents also appear in the Microsoft Defender portal. AlertBacked needs the workspace in this resource group; the alarms table is deployed with it.
Enable audit logging to Log Analytics custom table
Data Collection Rule logs ingestion endpoint (required if EnableAuditLogging=true)
Data Collection Rule immutable ID (required if EnableAuditLogging=true)
Audit DCR resource ID, the audit infrastructure template's dcrId output (required if EnableAuditLogging=true, otherwise ingestion returns 403)
Enable writing alarms to custom Log Analytics table (SOCRadar_Alarms_CL)
Data Collection Endpoint URL (required if EnableAlarmsTable=true)
Alarms DCR immutable ID (required if EnableAlarmsTable=true)
Alarms DCR resource ID, the alarms infrastructure template's alarmsDcrId output (required if EnableAlarmsTable=true, otherwise ingestion returns 403)
Stream name for alarms DCR
Internal: Logic App starts 3 min after deploy for role propagation
Resource group of the existing Microsoft Sentinel workspace. Leave default if workspace is in same RG.
Microsoft Sentinel role for the Logic App. Responder sufficient for incident ops (least-privilege).

Extract IP, domain and URL indicators from alarm details and attach them to the incident as entities. Requires Microsoft Sentinel Contributor for this playbook because bookmark write is not included in Responder. When false, the identity keeps the SentinelRoleLevel role.

body.query: print raw = base64_decode_tostring('@{base64(outputs('Compose_IoC_Source'))}') | extend Urls0 = extract_all(@'(https?://[^\s"<>\]\)},;\\]+)', raw) | extend nourl = replace_regex(raw, @'https?://[^\s"<>\]\)},;]+', ' ') | extend Ips0 = extract_all(@'\b((?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|[1-9]?[0-9])(?:\.(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|[1-9]?[0-9])){3})\b', nourl) | extend Doms0 = extract_all(@'\b((?:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}\.)+(?:[a-z]{2}|com|net|org|info|biz|edu|gov|mil|int|app|dev|cloud|online|site|shop|club|live|link|xyz|top|icu|buzz|tech|store|space|website|host|press|digital|agency|solutions|services|systems|network|email|group|world|life|today|news|media|works|zone|center|company|expert|tools|support|care|best|run|click|download|stream|review|date|loan|men|win|bid|trade|party|science|work|wiki|fun|rest|quest|monster|cyou|sbs|lol|help|pro|name|mobi|asia|tel|travel|jobs|museum|aero|coop|cat|post|blog|page|ninja|guru|team|design|studio|software|finance|capital|fund|bank|insure|legal|clinic|health|dental|vision|coach|academy|school|college|university|institute))\b', tolower(nourl)) | mv-expand D = iff(array_length(Doms0) == 0, dynamic(['']), Doms0) to typeof(string) | where isempty(D) or (D != 'socradar.com' and D !endswith '.socradar.com' and not(D matches regex @'\.(png|jpe?g|gif|svg|ico|css|js|txt|json|xml|csv|pdf|docx?|xlsx?|pptx?|exe|dll)$')) | summarize Ips0 = take_any(Ips0), Urls0 = take_any(Urls0), Doms = make_set_if(D, isnotempty(D)) | mv-expand U = iff(array_length(Urls0) == 0, dynamic(['']), Urls0) to typeof(string) | extend U = trim_end(@'[.,;:!?\\]+', U) | summarize Ips0 = take_any(Ips0), Doms = take_any(Doms), Urls = make_set_if(U, isnotempty(U)) | project Ips = array_sort_asc(set_union(Ips0, dynamic([]))), Domains = array_sort_asc(set_union(Doms, dynamic([]))), Urls = array_sort_asc(set_union(Urls, dynamic([])))

properties.description: Raises one alert, and one incident, for every SOCRadar alarm the import Logic App writes to SOCRadar_Alarms_CL. Deployed only when IncidentMode is AlertBacked.
properties.query:
SOCRadar_Alarms_CL
| where ingestion_time() > ago(10m)
| where toupper(Status) == "OPEN"
| where isnotempty(AlarmId)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AlarmId
| extend AlarmUrl = strcat("https://platform.socradar.com/company/", CompanyId, "/alarm/", AlarmId)
| extend SentinelSeverity = case(toupper(Severity) in ("CRITICAL", "HIGH"), "High", toupper(Severity) == "MEDIUM", "Medium", "Low")
| extend AlarmDescription = strcat(substring(AlarmText, 0, 1500), "\n\nSOCRadar severity: ", toupper(Severity))
| project TimeGenerated, AlarmId, CompanyId, Title, AlarmText, AlarmDescription, AlarmMainType, AlarmSubType, Severity, Status, AlarmDate, AlarmUrl, SentinelSeverity
| order by TimeGenerated asc
| take 149
